summary: Findings t3 and t6 of the discover run over the modal sense-fork nodes (attempt 79049691, deferred there for the PR file limit) are registered: NecessaryPredecessorLifting strengthens NoNovelNecessarySupport (third conjunct; the weak version's necessity hypothesis on the source is unused) and strengthens NoContingentGroundOfNecessary (first conjunct), both conjunct projections declared as assembly transcriptions. Strictness controls, checked with zero axioms and serving as separators: (a) contingent-source model (worlds and individuals Bool, universal frame, actual world false, true exists everywhere, false only at world true, false supports true only at world true): no novel necessary support holds vacuously and lifting fails; (b) non-actual-edge model (both individuals exist everywhere, same edge): no contingent ground holds and lifting fails. Certified differences with no background: lifting iff no novel support and every possible supporter of a necessary individual is necessary and actual (SupportersOfNecessaryNecessaryAndActual); lifting iff no contingent ground and every possible support edge into a necessary individual recurs as a present edge at the actual world (SupportOfNecessaryRecursActually). The other bridge is not a background-free delta for either pair: lifting_of_two_bridges needs ActualReflexive to supply the supporter's actual existence, so the deltas carry that existence themselves. strong_version_needed is recorded on the three arguments that use lifting (NECESSARY-UNDERIVED-POSITIVE-LIFT, NECESSARY-UNDERIVED-NONREFUTATION-LIFT, the same-witness underived argument 78dfeded): each uses both the supporter's necessity and its actual edge.
